title: meta overlays: unnormalized type segment creates phantom rows that shadow the code-authored listing and cannot be deleted
body:
Found while verifying the 17.0.0-rc.1 checklist on #3909 (F1). Verified on `main` @ `1ee48bc60`, showcase under `os serve --dev`, admin session.

#3985 made the `/meta` **per-type gates** accept both spellings of the type segment — but the **customization-overlay write path does not normalize it**, so the two spellings address two different overlay namespaces, and the phantom rows this creates corrupt every listing surface that should have been artifact ∪ overlay.

## Repro & observed (one fresh boot, in order)

1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/actions/rc1_probe` (plural) → `200 … Saved customization overlay … type=actions, name=rc1_probe [seq=1]`
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/rc1_probe` (singular) → `200 … type=action, name=rc1_probe [seq=1]` — **a second, distinct row** (both seq=1).
3. `GET /api/v1/meta/actions` (plural — the spelling the showcase's 11 code-authored actions listed under before step 1) now returns **only `rc1_probe`** — one overlay row shadows the entire code-authored action list on that spelling. `GET /api/v1/meta/action` (singular) returns the merged 12.
4. `DELETE /api/v1/meta/action/rc1_probe` → `200 … reset to artifact default [seq=2]`. `DELETE /api/v1/meta/actions/rc1_probe` → `200 … No customization overlay found for actions/rc1_probe — already at artifact default.` — **the plural row it created in step 1 is unreachable by either spelling**.
5. After both deletes: `GET /meta/actions` still returns the phantom `rc1_probe` (and still hides the 11 real actions); `GET /meta/action` still lists `rc1_probe` among 12 items, while `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_task/rc1_probe` correctly 404s. Listing and dispatch now disagree about a deleted item.
6. Throughout all of this, `sys_metadata` in the bound SQLite datasource holds **0 rows** (and `.objectstack/metadata` holds no matching file) — where these "env-wide, state=active" overlays actually persist is not observable; on this boot they appear to be process-memory only.

Also observed: after step 2 the overlay was **listed but not dispatchable for a short window** (`POST` answered the ADR-0110 "has no declaration" 404, then succeeded on a later call) — some cache between `saveMeta` and `resolveRouteActionDeclaration` lags the write.

## Expected

- One canonical type key at the save/read/delete boundary (`pluralToSingular`, the same fold #3985 applied to the gates) — a plural-spelled PUT lands in the same namespace as a singular one.
- `GET /meta/<type>` on either spelling = code-artifact items ∪ active overlays, never overlay-only.
- DELETE removes the row it addresses; a deleted overlay leaves every surface (list, get, dispatch) in agreement.

Part of the #3909 rc.1 verification (section F1).
